controls.description:
The corner indicators shown over a running game: the achievement being attempted, how far along a measured one is, and the live value of a leaderboard attempt.
These used to live in VideoFullScreen.xml and never appeared. Where the game has its own DRM plane the GUI layer is only composited when something dirties it, and a control quietly becoming visible was not enough. Kodi opens this dialog instead, which is - and keeps the layer compositing for as long as it is up.
Kodi only opens it while there is something to show, so an empty dialog is never on screen.

control.description: A grouplist rather than three placed groups: one that is not showing takes no room, so the rest close up on their own. Stacking them by hand needed a slide animation per indicator conditioned on which of the others happened to be visible, which does not survive a fourth.
